name: sulfacetamide
uses: INDICATIONS AND USAGE Sulfacetamide sodium ophthalmic solution USP, 10% is indicated for the treatment of conjunctivitis and other superficial ocular infections due to susceptible microorganisms, and as an adjunctive in systemic sulfonamide therapy of trachoma: Escherichia coli, Staphylococcus aureus, Streptococcus pneumoniae, Streptococcus (viridans group), Haemophilus influenzae, Klebsiella species, and Enterobacter species. Topically applied sulfonamides do not provide adequate coverage against Neisseria species, Serratia marcescens and Pseudomonas aeruginosa . A significant percentage of staphylococcal isolates are completely resistant to sulfa drugs.
pediatric: Pediatric Use Safety and effectiveness in infants below the age of two months have not been established.
contra: CONTRAINDICATIONS Sulfacetamide sodium ophthalmic solution USP, 10% is contraindicated in individuals who have a hypersensitivity to sulfonamides or to any ingredient of the preparation.
interactions: Drug Interactions Sulfacetamide preparations are incompatible with silver preparations.
